# RolloutWatch

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_component_agents.py from xrds/rolloutwatch.meta.yaml; edit the sidecar, not this file. -->

Watches one app environment's Argo Rollout; on Degraded it dispatches a HolmesGPT diagnosis Job (at most once per revision) and records the phase in status.

## How it is requested

Rendered by the airframe-application chart from an app's values file; not requested directly.

## Verify a live XR

```
tools/airframe-verify rolloutwatch <namespace>/<name> [--context CTX]
```

Read-only. Steps, after the implicit `xr-synced` check:

- `xr-ready` (condition): The RolloutWatch XR is Ready.
- `rollout-healthy` (xrField): status.rolloutPhase is Healthy: the watched Rollout's last observed phase.

## Editing this composition

- Rendered by function-rollout-watcher (Python, functions/function-rollout-watcher, released by its own workflow). It emits a Normal event only when the observed phase changes, and dispatches at most one diagnosis Job per degraded revision.

Contract: `tools/airframe-capabilities verify rolloutwatch`; schema: `xrds/rolloutwatch.yaml`.
